prompt:
You are a senior financial analyst in Microsoft Corporation's FP&A team. The VP of Finance has asked you to prepare a quarterly variance analysis for the Q3 FY2026 earnings call preparation. This analysis will help leadership understand the sequential and year-to-date performance drivers across key P&L and balance sheet metrics. Your deliverable will be circulated to the CFO and investor relations team.

The attached file contains Microsoft's XBRL financial data for Q1-Q3 FY2026 and FY2025 sourced from SEC EDGAR filings.

Prepare an Excel workbook with the following tabs:

1. Summary - A dashboard-style sheet with the company name, ticker (MSFT), CIK (0000789019), sector (tech_software), and the reporting period covered. Include a brief narrative (2-3 sentences) summarizing the most material sequential change observed.

2. Income Statement Variance - For each of RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax, CostOfGoodsAndServicesSold, GrossProfit, OperatingIncomeLoss, NetIncomeLoss, and ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense, build a three-column comparison: Q2 FY2026, Q3 FY2026 (quarterly figures), and the Q2-to-Q3 variance (both dollar amount and percentage). Calculate the variance as (Q3 - Q2) / Q2. Use quarterly values (the second value listed under each period in the data). Apply number formatting with commas and one decimal place for percentages.

3. Balance Sheet Variance - For Assets, Liabilities, StockholdersEquity, and CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue, show Q2 FY2026, Q3 FY2026, and the Q2-to-Q3 dollar and percentage variance. Use the first value listed for each period (the cumulative/period-end balance). Apply the same variance formula.

4. EPS Analysis - Present EarningsPerShareDiluted for Q1 FY2026, Q2 FY2026, and Q3 FY2026 (quarterly figures). Calculate the Q1-to-Q2 and Q2-to-Q3 absolute changes and percentage changes.

5. YTD Summary - Compute cumulative nine-month figures for RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax, CostOfGoodsAndServicesSold, GrossProfit, OperatingIncomeLoss, NetIncomeLoss, and ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense by summing the quarterly values for Q1, Q2, and Q3 FY2026. Present the Q1, Q2, Q3 individual quarters plus the YTD total in columns.

Formatting requirements: All dollar amounts must use the format $#,##0 (millions scale, divide raw values by 1,000,000 and label headers as ($ in millions)). Percentages must display as 0.0%. Bold all header rows and total/subtotal rows. Use light blue fill for header cells. Ensure every numeric cell has a border.
